title: Rej Junkman
body:
Description

Rej Junkman is an NPC who expands your land in your property. He can be found in the Resource Hub.

Appearance

Rej's appearance is the same as Jer Junkman, albeit with different clothing. He has yellow sunglasses, a black cap, a stopwatch and a tuxedo, unlike Jer Junkman which wears overalls.

Dialogue

"Buy land here, right now!" - interaction prompt

When interacted with:

  • "Hey, I'm Rej. Do you want to buy some property?"
    • Okay! (enters expand property menu)
    • No, thank you. (leaves conversation)

Trivia

  • Rej's name is Jer's name backwards.
    • This could imply that Rej Junkman is some sort of doppelganger to Jer Junkman.
  • In theory, Rej, Jer and Jerry Junkman could be siblings.
  • As of now, Rej Junkman is practically useless, as you can expand land using the Build Menu.
